name: Sanitary Napkin Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
benefit: 1. Under the scheme, free sanitary napkins will be provided to the daughters of registered construction workers and to women construction workers.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The benefits of the scheme will be provided to the daughters of registered construction workers and to women construction workers registered with the Board.
